comment: There is no published source: sourceUrl is empty in the installed plugin.json and the maker's repository holds only the manuals and two changelogs. Everything here comes from the v2.1.0 manual PDF, the installed panel image res/MiniHyphae.png and the census names. Input index 1 is configured with no name and has no jack on the panel, so it has no line and no tag. The census records the same position for the three Randomize knobs, the three Modifier Mode switches, the three attenuverters and the three modifier jacks, and those positions fall near the top left of the panel while the Modifiers row is drawn across the bottom: the whole row appears to be measured inside its own container. The three modifiers are identical to one another, so one line covers each set; the Randomize knob and the Direct CV attenuverter share a position because they are the same knob under the two modifier modes, and both are tagged. The trigger jacks latch against 2V rather than the 1V a button uses, so a 1V trigger does not fire them.
